description: Compare climates of US places — Compare 30-year NOAA climate normals for 2-4 US places side by side (relocation, travel, site selection): average high/low, rain, snow, hot days, freeze days, pleasant months, with rankings (warmest, driest, snowiest, mildest extremes, most pleasant). Params: places= separated by | (e.g. Nashville, TN|Denver, CO|Phoenix, AZ); optional month=1-12. Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).
